source_datasets.name: Wohnbevölkerung am wirtschaftlichen Wohnsitz nach institutionellen Gliederungen und Religion, 1970-2000

indicators.label: Census population total
indicators.description: Full-count federal census population at economic residence in the FSO religion cube.
indicators.method: Read from the Religion - Total category for each canton-year.
indicators.quality_notes: The PX cube reports all years on the source's institutional canton frame; Jura is present in the 1970 row before the 1979 canton creation.

indicators.label: Census religious-affiliation share
indicators.description: Share of the census population with a stated religious affiliation, excluding Keine Zugehörigkeit and Ohne Angabe from the numerator.
indicators.method: 100 * (Religion - Total - Keine Zugehörigkeit - Ohne Angabe) / Religion - Total.
indicators.quality_notes: This is a census affiliation construct and must not be compared as one time series with the structural survey estimates.

indicators.label: Census no-religion share
indicators.description: Share of the census population recorded as Keine Zugehörigkeit.

visual_layers.label: Census religious-affiliation share
visual_layers.description: Full-count census affiliation share by canton.
visual_layers.notes: Census construct only; not a structural-survey continuation.

visual_layers.label: Census no-religion share
visual_layers.description: Full-count census no-religion share by canton.
